1. Extend the image by the support with the border mode and scale it to 0 to 1.
2. Read the 16 circle pixels around each pixel.
3. Test for a run of n circle pixels that are all brighter or all darker.
4. Score the pixels that pass, and give 0 to the rest.
5. For corner points, keep the local maxima of the score, and cut the extension off.
